Broken Dawn Antiviral Race

The source-specific Broken Dawn pursuit of a possible broad-spectrum antiviral, with April Kelleher and Division Agents racing a Mantis-directed operation to reach the Ann Arbor research lead.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

A possible antiviral, not a finished cure

Broken Dawn's published premise centers on a potential broad-spectrum antiviral. The archive records that as a source-specific research lead and does not promote it into a confirmed cure for the wider franchise. [1][2][3]

The race for Ann Arbor

The licensed novel frames the Ann Arbor site as a contested research destination. April, Aurelio and their allies work to protect the lead while the Mantis-directed operation tries to control it; the resulting intelligence moves on to Washington. [3]
